name: mixmax-sales-leader-weekly
description: Weekly cross-period Sales Leader report for Mixmax. Synthesizes the most recent Mixmax Quarterly + Quarter-Ahead reports + the latest Gen 1 weekly snapshot into a private Sales Leader brief: MTD pacing, must-win deals, rep health dashboard, coaching notes, top-10 accounts, stuck/pull-in deals, quarter-ahead red flags, and the Monday meeting agenda. Publishes to GitHub Pages. Requires mixmax-publishing-core.
